Matching._comment: Candidate pipeline policy, all config-owned (Doc 01 §9.1). Values below equal the frozen W5 baseline.
Matching._stagesComment: DSI-021 progressive search. Radii/budgets are configuration; they must be strictly increasing.

Worker._comment: B-REC-01 durable worker cadence and bounded recovery backoff.

Services._comment: Compose provides Services__DriverBaseUrl (service DNS). Local default below.

DriverClient._comment: Attempt timeout budget is owned by W6 (Doc 02 §20). 5s is a placeholder, not frozen.

RabbitMq._comment: W9 terminal Outbox publishing uses the same broker connection settings; consumers keep their frozen queue names.

Outbox._comment: Operational tuning for C's shared relay. RelayId is generated per process (machine + random) and is not frozen configuration.
